init_GPT_connector: initialize a GPT connector with a pretrained OpenAI GPT model from a directory or HuggingFace cache
get_id_tokenize_string: tokenize a string and convert it to token IDs using the GPT tokenizer
get_batch_generation_masked: generate batch log probabilities for sentences with MASK tokens using the GPT model
get_contextual_embeddings: extract contextual embeddings from sentences using the GPT transformer encoder
review_GPT_class: review the GPT class that wraps OpenAI GPT for masked language modeling and embeddings
